dispatches.message:
Terminid spores have engulfed Heeth and Angel's Venture, spawning hordes of Terminids that overwhelmed our colonial militias. Clearly, the bug hive instinct oriented their mindless expansion towards dishonoring the memory of those who fought to free these planets.

Your fellow Helldivers paid for these lands with their lives. We cannot lose them now. Hold the planets until SEAF reinforcements arrive.

The Advanced Liberation Tools Research Agency (ALTRA) has tested successful prototypes of a new combat asset. Helldivers are advised to review proper mechanical operation procedures in preparation for the incoming asset.

NEW MAJOR ORDER
Tien Kwan is home to the sole arsenal of new Exosuit technology. It is only a matter of time before the Automatons discover the arsenal and steal it for themselves. Liberate Tien Kwan, before it's too late.

AUTOMATON COUNTERATTACK
Intercepted messages indicate bot plans for a significant push. Increased resistance on Automaton planets is anticipated.

Well done, Helldivers. Tien Kwan has been returned to the care of Managed Democracy. The Morgunson Arsenal, and its stockpile of freshly-produced Exosuits, were recovered intact.

The EXO-45 PATRIOT EXOSUIT is now available for requisition.

Upon each Barrier Planet now stands a network of massive, Termicide-dispensing towers: the Terminid Control System. Once activated, the TCS will exterminate every Terminid on that planet, and inoculate it against all future infestations. 

However, surges in Terminid activity have forced the SEAF Engineers to evacuate. Now, only the Helldivers can ensure the safety of our citizens.

The Terminid Control System must be activated—at any cost.

NEW MAJOR ORDER
Activate Terminid Control System

FENRIR III SECURED
The Terminid Control System is now fully activated on Fenrir III.

TURING SECURED
The Terminid Control System is now fully activated on Turing.
The TCS has been fully activated on half of the Barrier Planets.

XENOENTOMOLOGY CENTER DAMAGED The Xenoentomology Center on Turing has been significantly damaged by the Illuminate, resulting in an outbreak of mutated specimens that had been kept securely under study. As a result, VELD has come under attack by the Predator Strain.

MERIDIA SECURED
The Terminid Control System is now fully activated on Meridia.

ERATA PRIME SECURED
The Terminid Control System is now fully activated on Erata Prime.

The Terminid Control System is fully activated. The Termicide is working as intended, culling millions of Terminids on the Barrier Planets.  Our citizens may finally rest easy, knowing their children are forever safe from being eaten alive by fascist insects.

NEW MAJOR ORDER

In support of civilian population expansion and new energy demands for FTL travel, the Helldivers are ordered to cull the Terminid swarm within the Quarantine Zone through liberation of several planets.

CYBERSECURITY UPDATE
A recent systems security breach has resulted in Galactic War tables displaying inaccurate information. The breach has been addressed, and all systems have been returned to normal operation.  Any discrepancies are to be considered the result of dissident misinformation.

Rest assured that the parties responsible have been identified, arrested, tried, and executed.

INTELLIGENCE BRIEF
A new strain of flying Terminids has suddenly appeared across all Terminid planets, with no prior warning or indication of any kind. While the Ministry of Intelligence has always known this was a possibility, the abruptness of the evolution indicates a high possibility of dissident concealment.

The deployment of Termicide was fortuitously timed—doubtlessly, it averted an even worse evolution. Helldivers are advised to exterminate these mutations whenever encountered.

MAJOR ORDER FAILED

Though many Terminids have been mercifully culled, the Helldivers were unable to penetrate as far inside the Quarantine Zone as ordered.

The expansion of our citizens to new planets will be reduced in line with the reduction of expected Element 710 to be produced. Further procreation applications will be denied until further notice.

NEW MAJOR ORDER

Civilian Biomass Collection Teams (BCTs) are gathering and processing inert Terminids. The Helldivers must maintain our control of the planets until these operations are complete.

TERMINID SURGE
Ministry of Science reports an unanticipated spike in Terminid spore counts. Expect a severe increase in resistance on Terminid planets.

MAJOR ORDER SUCCEEDED

The last of the crude solid E-710 has been collected, processed, and shipped off-planet, providing a healthy boost to our colony settlement efforts. The planets can now be left behind to allow the Terminids to repopulate—under careful supervision.

NEW MAJOR ORDER Interrogators have extracted alarming information from captured bots, through use of Unpleasant Sensory Experience Simulations. The Automatons are planning something called "The Reclamation," which appears to be a massive invasion of unprecedented scale. Further details are scarce. In response, High Command has authorized OPERATION SWIFT DISASSEMBLY. The objective: eradicate the Automatons entirely. It will consist of several phases, each critical to overall success.

OPERATION SWIFT DISASSEMBLY PHASE I: Disrupt Communications. We have identified a long-range communications array deep in Automaton space. Its capture may reveal critical intelligence about the enemy's plans.

ARSENAL EXPANSION NOTICE In order to support the destruction of the Automatons, the Ministry of Defense has fast-tracked new support weapons for immediate distribution. The LAS-99 Quasar Cannon and MG-101 Heavy Machine Gun are now available for requisition.

OP SWIFT DISASSEMBLY, PHASE I—COMPLETED The Automaton Comms Array on Troost has been decommissioned. Strangely, it appears to have been broadcasting outside the Galactic Frontier. Analysts are working to determine more, but much data was already deleted. However, we did discover a transmission containing blueprints for a new Automaton type: aerial gunships. With this advance warning, our hardworking factory laborers have been instructed to accelerate production of our most effective anti-air weaponry.

NEW MAJOR ORDER OP SWIFT DISASSEMBLY, PHASE II: Reduce Non-Sentient Combatant Production. Intel analysis have identified the planet Tibit as the most significant producer of illegal Automaton combatants. Liberating this planet would significantly impact the enemy's capacity to replenish decommissioned socialists. It would also limit further theft of the planet's natural resources from future generations of inarguably sentient humans.

tacticalActions.name: EAGLE STORM
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Deploys periodic Eagle Gas Strikes during missions. Slows enemy progress in Defense Campaigns.

tacticalActions.name: ORBITAL BLOCKADE
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Defense Campaigns cannot originate from this planet. The Hellpod Space Optimization Booster is automatically active for all missions.

tacticalActions.name: HEAVY ORDNANCE DISTRIBUTION
tacticalActions.strategicDescription: Gives access to the Orbital 380mm HE Barrage stratagem during missions. Accelerates progress in Liberation Campaigns.

news.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

To honor the fallen, the government has authorized the construction of The Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights. However, enemy aggression threatens this project. 

Their occupation of Super Earth territories rich in rare metals, crude oil, and radioactive isotopes, among others, steals from the prosperity of all. This is an insult to the memory of our heroes. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate FURY, ESKER, and ZEA RUGOSIA.

news.original:
MAJOR ORDER WON

Thanks to the Helldivers’ philanthropic bravery and altruistic lethality, the AIR (Anti-Illuminate Restitution) initiative has been funded to its maximum level. Every revered Class A orbital retirement facility affected by recent Illuminate interference has now received a heavily subsidised upgrade to their respiratory fortification package.

With regional real estate futures fully stabilized and all corporate liabilities mitigated, the Helldivers stand triumphant.

区域房地产期货逐步走向完全稳定，而且所有企业债务有所减轻，绝地潜兵昂首告捷。

CONTROL CENTER ADVISORY

Upon completion of this Campaign, Helldivers will receive permanent access to the DSS Eagle Gas Storm Tactical Action.

The technician responsible for mislabeling this performance incentive as a Stratagem in the Control Center has committed to thoroughly understanding the distinction between a Tactical Action and a Stratagem during an intensive re-education seminar, alongside their immediate family.

MAJOR ORDER ADJUSTMENT

Ongoing analysis of current major order has identified a reprioritization of objectives. Helldivers are called to immediately assist SEAF in the defense of Senge-23 by culling huge swaths of illuminates. The target for mission operations is deprioritized.
news.translated:
重要指令调整

对当前重要指令的持续分析显示，目标优先级已重新排序。绝地潜兵即刻驰援SEAF，协防Senge-23，大规模清剿光能者。原定作战任务目标优先级下调。

Additionally, a complete recalibration of SEAF aerosol payloads has resulted in Class A retirees happily reporting an immediate improvement to their well-deserved scenic views, and an abundance of pristine, pine-scented air.

WARFRONT DEVELOPMENT

SEAF Battalions previously recalled to secure voting sites as detailed in the "Blazing Electorate" campaign are now returning to the frontlines. Trigger dicipline encouraged, democratic fervor mandatory.

战线动态

此前为保卫投票站点而撤回的SEAF部队，即“炽热选民”行动中所部署的兵力，现已重返前线。鼓励保持扳机纪律，民主热情必须高涨。

Helldivers: liberate MARFARK, targeted by the Incineration Corps, and MENKENT, targeted by the Jet Brigade to forcibly deny these baseless, unlawful socialist fabrications—and their craven falsehoods.

major_order.title: MAJOR ORDER
major_order.brief: Liberate the designated planets to secure the raw materials needed to properly honor our fallen heroes.
major_order.translated_brief: 解放指定行星，确保获取用以妥善缅怀阵亡英雄所需的原材料。

active_campaign.title: MEMORIAM ETERNAL
active_campaign.label: ACTIVE CAMPAIGN
active_campaign.description: With the approach of Liberty Day, the Super Earth Government has authorized the construction of the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights. The Helldivers are needed to bravely acquire the material resources needed to honor the fallen heroes of the Second Galactic War.
active_campaign.description_cn: 随着自由日的临近，超级地球政府已批准建造麦拉芬蒙河人权纪念与审讯中心。需要绝地潜兵勇敢地获取所需物资资源，以纪念第二次银河战争的阵亡英雄。

phases.title: HONOR THE FALLEN
phases.briefing:
Liberty Day approaches, and with it, the responsibility to honor the memories of fallen heroes. The Super Earth Government has passed a bill authorizing the construction of a memorial worthy of their sacrifices: the Malevelon Creek Memorial & Interrogation Center for Human Rights.

As the name implies, the Memorial would honor the fallen not just in thought, but in action: through enhanced interrogation of dissidents and enemies of Freedom.

However, wanton aggression from all 3 enemy factions threatens this project. Their occupation of Super Earth territories rich in rare metals, crude oil, and radioactive isotopes, among others, steals from the prosperity of all. This is an insult to the memory of our heroes. The Helldivers are ordered to liberate FURY, ESKER, and ZEA RUGOSIA.
phases.briefing_cn:
自由日临近，随之而来的是缅怀阵亡英雄记忆的责任。超级地球政府已通过一项法案，批准建造一座配得上他们牺牲的纪念碑：麦拉芬蒙河人权纪念与审讯中心。

顾名思义，这座纪念中心不仅要在思想上缅怀阵亡者，更要在行动上缅怀：通过对异见者和自由之敌进行强化审讯。

然而，全部3个敌方阵营的肆意侵略威胁着这一项目。他们占领了富含稀有金属、原油和放射性同位素等资源的超级地球领土，窃取了本属于全体人民的繁荣。这是对我们英雄记忆的侮辱。绝地潜兵奉命解放费里、艾斯科尔和泽亚鲁戈西亚。
